notes: The supplied Coach, Intercity Bus and City Bus category pages were used as the scope.
Recommended products from unrelated categories shown at the top of pages were not imported unless they also appeared in the requested category's actual product list.
The Intercity page repeats YBL6121H in the listing; it is stored only once.
ASIASTAR/YAXING pages sometimes show a marketing page name and a slightly different detailed model suffix (for example JS6128GH -> JS6128GHP). Both are retained in the product name where useful.
All catalog products are inquiry-only until Strongbuilt confirms sourcing, homologation and availability in the Philippines.
